hero.title: Electrical Engineering (PG) in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A Master’s in Electrical Engineering is a postgraduate qualification for students interested in electrical power systems, electronics, renewable energy, smart grids, automation and electrical infrastructure. It can help engineering graduates develop specialised technical knowledge for careers in energy, utilities, manufacturing and technology. **Master’s in Electrical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** may be an option for graduates exploring related postgraduate specialisations in energy and smart electrical systems.

overview: Important course availability note: The University of Mauritius does not list a dedicated Master’s in Electrical Engineering in its published 2026–2027 postgraduate programme catalogue. However, it offers an MSc in Renewable Energy and Smart Electrical Systems, a two-year, part-time programme delivered fully online. This is a related specialisation, not the same qualification as a general Master’s in Electrical Engineering. Students researching **Study Electrical Engineering in Mauritius** should understand this distinction before applying.

faq.question: Is a Master’s in Electrical Engineering available in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A dedicated Master’s in Electrical Engineering was not found in the University of Mauritius’s published postgraduate list for 2026–2027. However, the university offers an MSc in Renewable Energy and Smart Electrical Systems, which is related to electrical engineering. This distinction is important for Master’s in Electrical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students comparing postgraduate options.

faq.question: Which university offers a related postgraduate course?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius offers the MSc in Renewable Energy and Smart Electrical Systems. It is a two-year, part-time programme delivered fully online.

faq.question: What are the eligibility requirements?
faq.answer: The published programme requirements include a recognised engineering or science degree, at least a second-class honours classification or an accepted equivalent, and IELTS 6.5 overall with no component below 5.5 or an accepted equivalent English qualification. Confirm the latest criteria directly with the university.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying Electrical Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The tuition fee should be confirmed with the university for the current intake. Indicative living expenses for a student living in Mauritius are estimated at MUR 15,000–25,000 per month, approximately ₹28,500–₹47,500 using the illustrative exchange rate in this article. Students taking the fully online programme from India may not need to pay for accommodation in Mauritius.

faq.question: What careers can I pursue after a postgraduate electrical engineering course?
faq.answer: Depending on the programme and your experience, potential roles include electrical engineer, power systems engineer, renewable energy engineer, electrical design engineer, automation engineer and energy systems analyst. Specialised positions may require additional technical experience or professional registration.
